name: Bank of America
notes: Researched from public bankofamerica.com pages only (no sign-in). The mock bill is a Bank of America auto loan. Online payments go through Online Banking (Bill Pay one-time or recurring, from checking or money market; customers without a deposit account may set up electronic payments from another bank), so methods are bank only. Automatic payments are set up in Bill Pay, on the paper form in the welcome package, or by phone; a confirmation letter with the start date arrives within 3-4 weeks and customers must keep paying until then (not modelled). Enrolling twice can cause double drafts. Phone payments: automated 800-215-6195, 24/7; agent-assisted phone payments carry a fee whose amount is not published (not modelled). Mail: PO Box 17237, Wilmington, DE 19886-7237. Up to 18 months of auto loan statements online; paperless path Profile & Settings > Paperless settings. Sign-in page asks for User ID and Password (links: Forgot user ID, Forgot password, Enroll). Customers who opted into an authorization code choose where it is sent; password reset sends a code to the phone (channel modelled as email_or_sms, inferred). No pay-without-sign-in option found for auto loans (inferred). Reviewed 2026-10-09: sign-in label corrected from Online ID to User ID (public sign-in page); added login help; apply line 844-892-6002 is for new applications. Footer/service phone set to the loan servicing line (contact.phone). Integrated 2026-10-10: labels.accountName "Auto Loan" (pages no longer say "Consumer Loan").

autopay.note: After you enroll, a letter confirming the first draft date arrives in 3-4 weeks; keep paying until then.

guest_pay.note: There is no pay-without-logging-in option for auto loans. Log in to Online Banking, or call 800-215-6195 to pay by phone.

help.title: Ways to pay your auto loan
paragraphs: In Online Banking, use Bill Pay to schedule a one-time or recurring payment from your Bank of America checking or money market account. No Bank of America deposit account? You may still be able to set up electronic payments from an account at another bank.

You can also pay through the automated phone system at 800-215-6195, available 24/7 (a same-day phone payment cannot be cancelled), by mail to Bank of America, N.A., PO Box 17237, Wilmington, DE 19886-7237 with your loan account number, or at any financial center.
Agent-assisted phone payments are available at the same number for a fee.

help.title: Setting up automatic payments
paragraphs: Log in to Online Banking and choose the Automatic/Recurring payments link in the Bill Pay menu, then follow the steps. You can also return the paper sign-up form from your welcome package (or the New Automatic Payment Sign Up section on the back of your statement) with a voided check by mail or fax, or call 800-215-6195 for help.
Within 3 to 4 weeks you will get a letter confirming when drafts begin. Keep making your payments until it arrives so you are not charged late fees.
Use only one enrollment method. Signing up both on paper and online can cause more than one payment to be taken each month.
steps: Open Bill Pay and choose Automatic/Recurring payments.
Pick your auto loan and the pay-from account.

help.title: Auto loan statements
paragraphs: Paper statements are mailed about 20 days before your due date; customers on automatic payments do not receive mailed statements.
You can sign up for eBills in Bill Pay and view and save up to 18 months of statements online while the loan is open.

help.title: Go paperless
paragraphs: In Online Banking go to Profile & Settings and then Paperless settings; in the mobile app open the Menu and choose Go Paperless. Changes usually apply from your next statement cycle.
Bank of America keeps copies of statements for up to 7 years.

help.title: Paying off your auto loan
paragraphs: Get a 10-day payoff quote in Online Banking under Manage your loan, by calling 800-215-6195 or at a financial center. You can pay it off through Bill Pay, by phone, by mail or in person.

After payoff, cancel any future Bill Pay payments. The lien release can take 10 to 12 business days, and the lien release, paid-in-full letter and paper title (if any) usually arrive 7 to 10 business days after that.

help.title: Contact auto loan customer service
paragraphs: Existing auto loan customers can call 800-215-6195, Monday to Friday 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. ET; automated phone payments and payoff quotes are available 24/7. To apply for a loan by phone, call 844-892-6002. Relay calls (711) are accepted and interpreters are free.

help.title: Help logging in
paragraphs: Enter your user ID and password. If you chose to use an authorization code, pick where the code should be sent and enter it. You may also be asked your challenge questions.

Forgot your user ID? Choose Forgot user ID and enter the email address tied to it; the ID is emailed to you. Forgot your password? Choose Forgot password, confirm your identity with a code sent to your phone, then set a new password of 8 to 20 characters.
